content_of_post_to_answer: Why do people change when they become successful?
answer: Success doesn't always change people; it changes the conditions under which their existing traits operate. Money, status, and influence reduce the need to please others and reveal how someone behaves when consequences become less immediate. Some become arrogant; others become more generous. I've explored related patterns in more detail on my profile. Perhaps success reveals character less than it removes the pressure to conceal it.
